title: Lezim Dance For Beginners | Learn Dance For Beginners | Indian Traditional Folk Dance Steps Tutorial

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The instructor demonstrates footwork counts and lezim stick movements step by step, first without music and then with music. She transitions through multiple variations of leg and stick routines, often accompanied by a second dancer.

lesson_structure.note: Adding lezim stick movements to leg steps
Two dancers performing together without music
Practicing the first variation with music

steps_taught.name: Leg Movements Variation 1
steps_taught.description: Stepping and tapping with leg raises while holding lezim sticks.

steps_taught.name: Leg Movements Variation 2
steps_taught.description: Alternative foot pattern with coordinated lezim strikes.

steps_taught.name: Leg Movements Variation 3
steps_taught.description: Stepping and knee lifts with overhead and downward lezim movements.

what_works: Breaking down footwork before adding arm and stick movements
Practicing both without music and with music
what_hinders: Lack of verbal explanation for intricate hand and stick angles

quotes.text: Ab hum ise lezim ke sath karte hai.
Ab hum ise dono sath mein milkar karte hai.
Ab hum ise music ke sath karte hai.

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher demonstrates footwork counting 1 through 8 while facing front.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact weight distribution on the floor

evidence_segments.observation: Teacher incorporates lezim sticks while performing leg steps on counts.
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: tension in the arms and wrists

evidence_segments.observation: Two dancers perform the sequence synchronously facing front.

extraction.distinctive_method: Progressing systematically from isolated footwork counts to stick integration, then dual-dancer practice, and finally full music execution.
